title: Correct "6 after a second review". The wording misdescribes the retained calls.
comment:
**Correct "6 after a second review". The wording misdescribes the retained calls.**

`inputs.ndjson` and `ledger.json` show three of the six review-driven refusals with only one review call:

- `luke-10-33-r1`, `luke-10-34-r1` and `daniel-7-9-r1` ran plan, plan, review.
- The evidence checks rejected their first plans.
- The review then rejected the re-plan.

Only `luke-10-34-r3`, `luke-10-34-r4` and `daniel-7-9-r2` had two reviews.

Replace "after a second review" with "when the review rejected the re-plan". Apply the same change to the "6 by review" wording in the outcome table (line 28) and to `llm/context/SCENE-PREPARATION.md` line 29. This file is the audit record, so the attribution must match the ledger.

```diff
-The pipeline refused 9 samples, all correctly, and refused no clean plan: 6 after a second review and 3 when the re-plan failed the evidence checks.
+The pipeline refused 9 samples, all correctly, and refused no clean plan: 6 when the review rejected the re-plan and 3 when the re-plan failed the evidence checks.
```
</details>
